# pidginhost_storage_products (Data Source)

Storage products (volume tiers) available for new volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_storage_products" "all" {}

output "storage_products" {
  value = { for p in data.pidginhost_storage_products.all.storage_products : p.slug => "${p.min_size}-${p.max_size} ${p.unit}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `storage_products` (Attributes List) Every storage product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_products))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_products`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Storage product id.
- `max_size` (Number) Largest size, in units.
- `min_size` (Number) Smallest size, in units.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `price` (String) Monthly price per unit, as a decimal string.
- `slug` (String) Short name of the product, accepted as a volume's product.
- `type` (String) Kind of storage.
- `unit` (String) Unit sizes and prices are counted in, such as GB.
